justification: The ghost inverts the core constraint entirely. The original establishes factual_people as a ratchet pinned ≤0.20 with strict downward-only mutation, forbidding imagination, rooted in the golden rule. The ghost replaces this with a 0.85 threshold, treats it as a fitness knob that loosens upward over time, and licenses imagination as beneficial. The loss is not partial or refinable—it is semantic inversion: the original's foundational stance (harm prevention, imagination forbidden for people, golden-rule governance) is replaced by its opposite (fitness-driven, imagination encouraged, higher chaos tolerance). This is not reformulation or detail loss; it is rejection of the controlling principle.
